mentions.name: AlphaCheck
mentions.description: Web app that uses stock market data to track the performance of stock recommendations made by YouTubers. Users can submit a video to get a snapshot of which stocks were mentioned, the sentiment (buy/sell), price delta and reasoning, or analyze a channel to get a performance 'report card' of that channel.
